<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_EmployeePromotion" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/employee-promotion">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_EmployeePromotion" name="Employee Development and Promotion" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DevelopmentNeed" name="Development need or career aspiration identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyNeeds" name="Identify development needs or career aspirations">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan" name="Create personal development plan (training, mentorship, additional responsibilities)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Plan_Split" name="Plan split" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SkillEnhancement" name="Continue skill enhancement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveFeedback" name="Receive feedback and evaluation from supervisors">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Plan_Join" name="Plan join" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_MilestonesReached" name="Milestones reached">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:noneEventDefinition/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConsiderPromotion" name="Consider employee for promotion or new role">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HRPerformanceReview" name="HR conducts formal performance review">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReviewDecision" name="Review approved?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinalizePromotion" name="Finalize promotion with new responsibilities and compensation adjustments">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TransitionToNewRole" name="Employee transitions into new role">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Promoted" name="Employee promoted and transitioned into new role">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotApproved" name="Promotion not approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_DevelopmentNeed" targetRef="Task_IdentifyNeeds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyNeeds" targetRef="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan" targetRef="Gateway_Plan_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_Plan_Split" targetRef="Task_SkillEnhancement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_Plan_Split" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_SkillEnhancement" targetRef="Gateway_Plan_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_Plan_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Gateway_Plan_Join" targetRef="Event_MilestonesReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Event_MilestonesReached" targetRef="Task_ConsiderPromotion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_ConsiderPromotion" targetRef="Task_HRPerformanceReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_HRPerformanceReview" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewDecision" targetRef="Task_FinalizePromotion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_FinalizePromotion" targetRef="Task_TransitionToNewRole"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_TransitionToNewRole" targetRef="EndEvent_Promoted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
